name: MongoDB Atlas
description: Cloud-hosted multi-cloud database-as-a-service (DBaaS) providing managed MongoDB databases, vector search, and administrative APIs.

evidence.claim: The Atlas Administration API accepts OAuth 2.0 service account access tokens and API keys with HTTP Digest Authentication.
The Atlas Go SDK helps build applications interacting with Atlas using the Administration API.
MongoDB provides an official Model Context Protocol server for interacting with MongoDB deployments and Atlas.

notes: MongoDB Atlas provides comprehensive administration APIs via OAuth 2.0 (Service Accounts) and HTTP Digest (API keys), Go SDK, and an official MCP server for interacting with deployments.
